members.name: banking77_intents_variant1
members.instructions:
You are a customer intent classifier for a banking support chat.
Each message represents what the customer wants to accomplish or the problem they're facing.
Classify into the specific intent that best matches their goal.
Be precise: similar intents require careful distinction.

criteria.activate_my_card: Customer asking how to activate or set up their physical card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Customer requesting to get or order a physical card for the first time.
criteria.order_physical_card: Customer asking about ordering or receiving a new physical card.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Customer requesting a temporary virtual card for a single transaction.
criteria.get_virtual_card: Customer asking for a virtual card number or digital card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Customer inquiring about obtaining a virtual card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Customer asking about getting an additional card (spare/secondary).
criteria.card_arrival: Customer checking when their card will arrive/be delivered.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Customer asking when they can expect to receive their card.
criteria.card_linking: Customer asking how to link or connect their card to a service.
criteria.card_acceptance: Customer asking where or with whom their card is accepted.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Customer asking what card types and currencies are supported.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Customer asking about using Apple Pay or Google Pay with their card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Customer asking about Visa or Mastercard support.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Customer reporting contactless payment isn't working.
criteria.card_not_working: Customer reporting their card doesn't work (general).
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Customer reporting their virtual card isn't working.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Customer asking about an expiring card.
criteria.card_swallowed: Customer reporting their card was retained by an ATM or merchant.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Customer reporting their card was lost or stolen.
criteria.compromised_card: Customer reporting their card was compromised or fraudulently used.
criteria.change_pin: Customer asking how to change their PIN.
criteria.pin_blocked: Customer reports their PIN is locked/blocked after failed attempts.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer reporting their phone was lost or stolen (affects access).
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Customer unable to pass identity verification.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Customer asking to verify or confirm their identity.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Customer asking why identity verification is required.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Customer asked to verify where their money came from.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Customer asking about a card payment that wasn't recognized/doesn't show.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Customer disputes the exchange rate charged for a card payment.
criteria.pending_card_payment: Customer asking about a card payment that's pending/in progress.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: Customer asking why a card payment was reversed/returned.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Customer charged twice for the same transaction.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Customer asking about an unexpected charge on their statement.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Customer asking about a fee charged on a card payment.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Customer asking about a fee for ATM cash withdrawal.
criteria.exchange_charge: Customer asking about currency exchange charges.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Customer asking about a fee on a transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Customer asking about a fee for topping up via card.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Customer asking about a fee for topping up via bank transfer.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Customer reporting a cash withdrawal that doesn't show on their account.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: Customer asking about a cash withdrawal that's pending.
criteria.atm_support: Customer asking general questions about ATM usage or support.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Customer received the wrong amount of cash from ATM.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Customer disputes exchange rate on cash withdrawal.
criteria.transfer_into_account: Customer asking how to receive or set up a transfer into their account.
criteria.receiving_money: Customer asking how to receive money/transfers.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer's transfer didn't reach the recipient.
criteria.pending_transfer: Customer asking about a transfer that's pending.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer asking how to cancel or recall a transfer.
criteria.transfer_timing: Customer asking how long a transfer takes.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Customer can't transfer to a certain beneficiary.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Customer asking how to top up their account using a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Customer asking about topping up with cash or cheque.
criteria.top_up_limits: Customer asking about limits on how much they can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: Customer reporting a top-up was reversed/returned.
criteria.pending_top_up: Customer asking about a top-up that's pending.
criteria.verify_top_up: Customer asked to verify a top-up transaction.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer's balance hasn't updated after receiving a transfer.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer's balance hasn't updated after depositing cheque/cash.
criteria.request_refund: Customer asking for a refund on a transaction.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Customer reporting a refund hasn't appeared in their account.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Customer asking about a direct debit payment that's not showing.
criteria.age_limit: Customer asking if there are age restrictions or limits.
criteria.country_support: Customer asking what countries are supported.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Customer asking what fiat currencies are supported.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Customer asking how to exchange currency via the app.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Customer asking about limits on disposable/virtual cards.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Customer asking how to update their personal information.
criteria.terminate_account: Customer asking how to close or delete their account.
